summary: Preserve default function/class declaration identity and default export binding semantics.

target.notes: Named declarations keep their local declaration binding; anonymous declarations still initialize default.

caveats: Function/class hoisting and TDZ details remain owned by FUNCTIONS/CLASSES rules.

tests.name: named function identity
tests.input:
// a.mjs: export default function f(){}; export const same=()=>f
// b.mjs: import d,{same} from './a.mjs'; console.log(d===same());

tests.name: anonymous class exported
tests.input:
// a.mjs: export default class { static x=1 }
// b.mjs: import C from './a.mjs'; console.log(C.x);
